```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("Code", "00_setup.R"))
source(here::here("Code", "01_functions.R"))
source(here::here("Code", "02_plot_style.R"))
library(knitr)
library(sf)
theme_set(theme_report())
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")

read_table <- function(file) fread(file.path(dir_tables, file), encoding = "UTF-8")
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ",")
deaths <- fread(derived_path("deaths_clean.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8")
deaths[, date := as.Date(date)]
non_accidental <- deaths[non_accidental == TRUE]
cause_labels <- c(
  non_accidental = "Non-accidental (A00-R99)", cardiopulmonary = "Cardiopulmonary (I00-I99, J00-J99)",
  cardiovascular = "Cardiovascular (I00-I99)", ischemic_heart = "Ischemic heart disease (I20-I25)",
  acute_myocardial_infarction = "Acute myocardial infarction (I21-I22)",
  hypertensive = "Hypertensive diseases (I10-I15)", cerebrovascular = "Cerebrovascular (I60-I69)",
  ischemic_stroke = "Ischemic stroke (I63)", hemorrhagic_stroke = "Hemorrhagic stroke (I60-I61)",
  respiratory = "Respiratory (J00-J99)", copd = "COPD (J41-J44)"
)
stopifnot(setequal(names(cause_labels), names(get_param("mortality", "cause_groups"))))
```

## Scope

Deaths of residents of the 33 study municipalities during the warm seasons
(1 November to 31 March) of 2009 to 2020, from the death records of the
Department of Health Statistics and Information (DEIS), and the analytic
dataset of the space-time-stratified case-crossover design.

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| file: ../Code/20_mortality_deis.R
#| code-summary: "Code/20_mortality_deis.R"
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| file: ../Code/21_case_crossover_dataset.R
#| code-summary: "Code/21_case_crossover_dataset.R"
```

## Source and selection

The input is the official DEIS file of deaths 1990-2023 (open data, one row per
death, with date, sex, age, municipality of residence and underlying cause).
The scripts read either that file or an extract of it with the same columns;
the run behind this page used the extract of residents of the Metropolitan
Region who died in 2009-2020.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-flow
#| tbl-cap: "Records kept at each step of the selection."
flow <- read_table("mortality_flow.csv")
kable(flow, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), col.names = c("Step", "Deaths"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-excluded
#| tbl-cap: "Deaths outside non-accidental mortality (A00-R99), by calendar year."
excluded <- read_table("mortality_excluded_causes.csv")
kable(dcast(excluded, cause ~ year, value.var = "deaths", fill = 0),
      format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

Non-accidental mortality follows the analysis plan: underlying cause between
A00 and R99. Two groups fall outside it. Injuries, coded S00-T98 with their
external cause in a second field, are the exclusion the plan asks for. The U
codes are COVID-19 (U07.1 and U07.2): `r fmt(excluded[grepl("COVID", cause), sum(deaths)])`
deaths in the warm-season months of 2020 are therefore not part of the
non-accidental series. Whether the months of the pandemic stay in the analysis
is a decision for the principal investigator.

`r fmt(deaths[age_years > 110, .N])` records have a recorded age above 110 years;
they stay in the oldest age group.

## Mortality by cause, age and sex

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cause-year
#| tbl-cap: "Deaths in the warm-season months by cause group and calendar year. The groups overlap: each sub-cause is part of its parent group."
cause_year <- read_table("mortality_by_cause_year.csv")
cause_wide <- dcast(cause_year, cause ~ year, value.var = "deaths", fill = 0)
cause_wide[, Total := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = setdiff(names(cause_wide), "cause")]
cause_wide <- cause_wide[match(names(cause_labels), cause)]
cause_wide[, cause := cause_labels[cause]]
kable(cause_wide, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-age-sex
#| tbl-cap: "Non-accidental deaths by age group and sex, warm seasons 2009-2020."
age_sex <- dcast(non_accidental[, .N, by = .(age_group, sex)], age_group ~ sex, value.var = "N", fill = 0)
age_sex[, total := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = setdiff(names(age_sex), "age_group")]
age_sex[, share := 100 * total / sum(total)]
kable(age_sex, digits = 1, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-daily
#| fig-cap: "Non-accidental deaths per day in the 33 municipalities by month of the warm season and calendar year."
#| fig-height: 3.8
daily <- non_accidental[, .N, by = date]
monthly <- daily[, .(per_day = mean(N)), by = .(year = year(date), month = month(date))]
monthly[, month := factor(month, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 11, 12),
                          labels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Nov", "Dec"))]
ggplot(monthly, aes(year, per_day)) +
  geom_line(colour = ramp_blue[6], linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(colour = ramp_blue[6], size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~month, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2010, 2015, 2020)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Deaths per day")
```

### By municipality

```{r}
#| label: fig-map-deaths
#| fig-cap: "Non-accidental deaths per year in the warm-season months, 2009-2020, and share of deaths at ages 85 or more."
#| fig-height: 4.8
#| fig-width: 9
shapes_env <- new.env()
load(input_path("municipality_shapes"), envir = shapes_env)
shapes <- shapes_env$comunas_santiago[, "cod_comuna"]
shapes$com <- as.integer(shapes$cod_comuna)
by_mun <- non_accidental[, .(per_year = .N / 12, oldest = 100 * mean(age_group == "85+", na.rm = TRUE)),
                         by = com]
map_values <- function(column, title, legend, hue, digits) {
  ggplot(merge(shapes, by_mun, by = "com")) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[column]]), colour = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_magnitude(name = legend, hue = hue,
                         labels = function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)) +
    labs(title = title) + theme_map()
}
patchwork::wrap_plots(
  map_values("per_year", "Deaths per year", "Deaths", "blue", 0),
  map_values("oldest", "Deaths at ages 85 or more", "%", "orange", 0), ncol = 2
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-municipality
#| tbl-cap: "Non-accidental deaths by municipality and calendar year, warm-season months."
mun_year <- read_table("mortality_by_municipality_year.csv")
mun_wide <- dcast(mun_year[group == "non_accidental"], municipality ~ year, value.var = "deaths", fill = 0)
kableExtra::scroll_box(
  kableExtra::kable_styling(kable(mun_wide, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ",")),
                            bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), font_size = 12),
  height = "380px"
)
```

The same table for every cause group, age group and sex is in
`Output/Tables/mortality_by_municipality_year.csv`. Counts are deaths, not
rates: population denominators enter with the attributable burden
(deliverable 3).

## The case-crossover dataset

Each non-accidental death is one stratum. Its referent days are all the days of
the same municipality, calendar year, month and day of the week: the day of
death and three or four control days. A month is either inside or outside the
warm season, so every control day is a warm-season day.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cc
#| tbl-cap: "Size of the case-crossover dataset."
kable(read_table("case_crossover_summary.csv"), format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
      col.names = c("Item", "Value"))
```

```{r}
#| label: cc-example
cc <- fread(derived_path("case_crossover.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8", nrows = 9)
kable(cc[, .(id, com, case_date, date, case, sex, age_group, icd3)],
      caption = "First rows of case_crossover.csv: two deaths with their referent days.")
```

`Data/Derived/case_crossover.csv` holds the structure and the attributes of
each death (sex, age group, cause flags). `Data/Derived/exposure_lagged.csv`
holds, for every municipality-day used as a referent, each exposure variable at
lags 0 to 3 (`<variable>_lag<k>` is the exposure k days earlier). Joining the two
on municipality and day gives the model dataset for any definition:

```r
library(survival)
cc <- fread("Data/Derived/case_crossover.csv")
lagged <- fread("Data/Derived/exposure_lagged.csv")
model_data <- merge(cc, lagged[, .(com, date, hw = hw_p95_2d_lag1, oz = o3_idw_gt_p75_lag1)],
                    by = c("com", "date"))
clogit(case ~ hw + oz + strata(id), data = model_data)
```

## Method checks

`tests/test_methods.R` checks the functions behind this page and the next
against independent calculations: the referent selection, the lagging, the
equivalence between the fit on individual records and the faster weighted fit
used in the models, the recovery of known odds ratios from simulated deaths,
and the delta-method intervals against `msm::deltamethod`.

```{r}
#| label: method-checks
#| code-summary: "Run tests/test_methods.R"
checks <- system2(file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript"),
                  shQuote(here::here("tests", "test_methods.R")), stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
if (!is.null(attr(checks, "status"))) stop(paste(checks, collapse = "\n"))
cat(grep("^ok|^All|simulated", checks, value = TRUE), sep = "\n")
```
